subject: Re: Freedom of Information / Historical Records Request - Mr. Williams, Cardiff Post Office Engineering Department, 1897 Marconi Lavernock Experiments
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Chris,

Thank you for confirming that FOI25766 is already open.

Please treat my email of 20 July as a clarification and continuation of
FOI25766 rather than as a new FOI request. I do not wish to open a separate
request.

I appreciate that Glamorgan Archives may hold historical archive material
relating to 1897. However, the clarification I submitted relates to whether
Cardiff Council, including any predecessor authorities, holds recorded
information created or retained in the course of its own functions.

Accordingly, I would be grateful if FOI25766 could address the points
raised in my email of 20 July, including confirmation of:

   - which Council departments were consulted;
   - what searches were undertaken;
   - whether Cardiff Council holds any records within the scope of that
   request; and
   - whether any relevant records have been transferred to Glamorgan
   Archives.

Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to your response under
FOI25766.

Kind regards,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)

Royal Signals Cyber & Electronic Warfare Professional & Life Member

> Dear Information Rights / Archives Team,
>
> I am writing to request information under the Freedom of Information Act
> 2000 (or equivalent records access) regarding my grandfather, Mr. Williams,
> who worked in the engineering department of the Cardiff Post Office /
> General Post Office around 1897.
>
> Specifically, I seek any records, personnel files, correspondence,
> reports, or mentions confirming his involvement in Guglielmo Marconi’s
> wireless telegraphy experiments at Lavernock Point (including erecting the
> 120-foot pole and related tests to Flat Holm). This relates to contemporary
> newspaper reports from May 1897.
>
> Please provide:
>
>    - Any personnel or service records for Mr. Williams in the Cardiff
>    engineering department circa 1897.
>    - Documents referencing "Mr. Williams" in connection with Marconi’s
>    demonstrations.
>    - Any other relevant historical files from the GPO
>    telegraph/engineering teams.
>
> My full name: Sion Buckler Address: [address redacted], Vale of
> Glamorgan, [postcode redacted]
> [map link redacted]
> Contact: [email redacted] Relationship: Great Grandson
>
> I am ultimately seeking any record about my great grandfather Mr Williams
> of Great House Farm, Llandough, Cardiff (formerly Vale of Glamorgan). Not
> to be confused with Great House Farm, Llandough, Cowbridge, Vale of
> Glamorgan. And his role in the Marconi experiment. And before and after
> Marconis stay with our family in our home in 1897.
>
> I am happy to provide further identification if required. Thank you for
> your assistance.
>
> Best regards,
>
> Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
